messages:
sam: FYI ALB started evicting targets in gpupool-us-west-2 around 12:07. Noticing readiness probe timeouts after an egress/ENI change.
infra-bot: Deploy roll: rolling update gpupool/node-pool-3 triggered at 12:02. ENI reassociation on nodes in subnet subnet-abc during scale-up.
leo: Seeing 503s on edge service and ALB target list dropped by ~4 targets.
sam: Quick dump from jump host — pod responds but ALB healthchecks are timing out. Suspect NAT path change losing the healthcheck source IP affinity.
sam: Repro curl from inside the VPC (pod IP answers fine):
```bash
curl -v --resolve edge.example:443:10.0.45.12 https://edge.example/healthz -H 'Host: edge.example'
```
ria: Note our readinessProbe has timeoutSeconds: 1. App sometimes hits ~800-900ms during GC or startup. Tight timeouts + short ALB unhealthy thresholds will amplify evictions.
maya: Confirming target type is IP. ALB healthcheck: HTTP /healthz 200, interval 10s, unhealthy threshold 2.
leo: ALB logs show healthcheck connections reset during ENI reassoc — NAT gateway briefly returns RST or drops packets (time window ~= 30-45s).
sam: Observed sequence: scale-up triggers ENI rotation (aws-eni reassign) -> egress SNAT port reuse and transient NAT mapping -> ALB HC packets get RST or no response -> target marked unhealthy -> deregister.
ria: Short-term mitigation: increase readinessProbe timeout and bump ALB unhealthy threshold. Suggest: readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds=3, periodSeconds=5 and ALB unhealthy threshold -> 5.
maya: Long term: pin egress for gpupool nodes (static ENI/NAT allocation) or move ALB to use instance target type with node-proxy healthcheck to avoid pod-level SNAT fragility.
sam: I'll kick a canary: update readiness and ALB thresholds for one AZ, monitor for 15m, then roll if stable. Also add jittered startup to avoid simultaneous GC spikes.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-162. Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-162 (assigned to @sam).
leo: Nice. After canary, let's also add a kube-affinity hook to delay ENI reassigns during rolling updates.
sam: ack. I'll post update in 20m with results. :thumbsup:
